Names that are yours

Username Checker is for names that are yours or that you are thinking of using. You must not use it to look up, monitor or harass another person. We may remove access if the app is misused.

What results mean

"Page found" means a public page with that name exists on that site; it does not show who owns it. "Nothing found" does not mean the name is free to register, so confirm with the site itself. "Couldn't check" means the site did not give a clear answer, for example because it was offline or blocked the request.

Other websites

The app opens public pages on other websites. Those sites are not ours, can change or block requests at any time, and results can therefore be incomplete or out of date.
